message: The power of Re-Crea dissipates into the air...
The world we live in was reclaiming its usual breath of life.

name: Azel
message: 「Did the Lord not show me the righteous path...」

name: Azel
message: 「What could I possibly have done wrong...」

name: Azel
message: 「Have I... been forsaken by the Lord...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...That is not true at all, Azel.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And now, God has accepted the way this world is.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Being this way is its natural form......」

name: Melilot
message: 「And you are right here within it too, Azel.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is nothing for you to worry about.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's definitely a place for you in our circle, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because we're classmates, and we're friends, aren't we?」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, we can keep expanding that circle more and more from here on out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Come believe in this world together with us, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because depending on how you feel, Azel, you can make anything happen.」
Gently laying down Azel, who has begun breathing softly in sleep.
Even if our feelings are still passing each other by for now...
We can just take our time from here on out and come to understand one another.
Because we fought hard and won that chance.

name: Bylous
message: 「It seems they won't show themselves just yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous... Thank you for your help this time.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I merely fought for my own sake.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...On top of all this, do you wish to fight even further?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Trading blows here with the Demon Lord who crossed the line of death alongside me wouldn't be bad.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I was able to unleash my power to my heart's content against Re-Crea, after all.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I'll save settling the score with the Demon Lord for another time.」

name: Bylous
message: 「The Demon Lord's power, amplified by the appearance of God...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You seem completely fixated on facing God.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Though I have no idea when that will be.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed... There is no way of knowing.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, I doubt God will ever cease putting us through trials.」

name: Bylous
message: 「God will definitely show themselves. Allow me to believe in that.」
Giving me one final glance, Bylous quietly walks away.
Leaving behind the premonition of a great battle bound to come again someday...
Without thinking, we take each other's hands and clasp them tightly.
Our eyes inevitably meet and hold.
And naturally, the distance between us closes...
Yet they don't let go of their joined hands.
Before long, the Holy Night Festival began.
After defeating Soltia, Bylous leaving, and putting Azel to rest in the infirmary...
Dazzling decorations shining before anyone noticed, and a solemn atmosphere.
There lies the same peaceful scenery of Ryuusei Academy as always.
She said that once she fulfilled her mission, she wanted to travel somewhere far away... She means back then.

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so, I feel like I've finally found the courage to take a step outside.」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to go anywhere you want to go, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're leaving that up to someone else?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You won't even think about it seriously for me, then...」

name: Synn
message: 「You're teasing me too, aren't you, Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, it's unfair if I'm the only one on the receiving end.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Since the two of us are standing side by side...」
Our shoulders brushed against each other.
We gazed into each other's eyes.

name: Melilot
message: 「So, where would you like to go?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right now, I'd like to go somewhere warm, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's quite a grand suggestion right off the bat...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wherever you want to go, Melilot-san, is where I want to go.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll make sure it's something you'll definitely love.」
The eyes right in front of me gently close.
In a silent conversation, we exchange our vow.

name: Melilot
message: 「Um, I'm not very good at dancing, or rather...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've never actually done it before, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Still, um, I've been wanting to try doing it at least as well as anyone else...」
Relying on the music echoing in the distance, the two of us take each other's hands.
Our faint, clumsy footsteps sway, blending into the snowy night.
Just like the path the two of us walk together...
Little by little, yet surely, we tread new steps.
